# Reverend Ez

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v3 c24 P3](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0003), [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Clergyman  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P14](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0014), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)</sub>
- **Titles:** Reverend  <sub>[v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)</sub>; Mr. Hale  <sub>[v3 c24 P18](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0018), [v3 c24 P21](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0021)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Ez  <sub>[v3 c24 P4](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0004), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

Ez is described as an extremely unattractive young man with a large, gangly frame and long legs. He has flaxen, limp, unkempt hair, green eyes, a large mouth, flaring ears, and a scholarly forehead. In the moonlight, however, he appears far less plain and radiates delightfulness.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)_

## Personality

Ez has a delightful voice and a soul of unquestionable beauty. He is cheerful, laughing and joking often, yet he is also serious, gentle, faithful, and dedicated to his sacred calling. He holds clear, firm convictions regarding his duty to God and humanity.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)_

## Traits

- Unattractive exterior but beautiful soul  <sub>[v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010), [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011)</sub>
- Delightful speaking voice  <sub>[v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011)</sub>

## Abilities

- Preaching inspiring and moving sermons  <sub>[v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c24 P16](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0016)</sub>
- Boating and fishing  <sub>[v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012)</sub>

## Goals

- To serve as a faithful clergyman and fulfill the religious labor assigned to him by God  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)</sub>
- To minister to the poor and serve the mission church in the Tanner Street slums  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c26 P6](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0006), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)</sub>

## History

Ezra Hale studied theology at St. Columbia and was a graduate of Wexcombe. During a summer break at Prospect Point, he took charge of the local mission church and stayed at Cousin Emily's boarding house. There he met Cressida Lindsay, with whom he went boating, fishing, and taking moonlight walks. Though initially resisting the ministry in his youth, he surrendered to his calling, delivering a powerful sermon at Prospect Point that deeply moved Cressy. While pursuing his studies at St. Columbia, he regularly visited Tabby's Place, where he won the fond high regard of everyone present despite Aunt Euphemia's feeling that theology students had lost some of their former gravity. He conducted slum prayer meetings and proposed to Cressy Lindsay, who accepted him. Upon finishing his studies in the spring, Ez married Cressy in Harborough, beamed with intense joy during the ceremony, and set out to serve at a mission church on Tanner Street in the slums.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P3](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0003), [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c25 P12](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0012), [v3 c26 P6](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0006), [v3 c27 P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## Background by volume

- Attended Wexcombe for his education  <sub>[v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012)</sub>
- Studied theology at St. Columbia  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)</sub>
- Resisted becoming a minister for a long time before accepting his calling  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)</sub>

## Quotes

> I attempted to be a different person for a extended period—I lacked the desire to be a clergyman. However, I eventually realized that it was the labor assigned to me—and with the assistance of God, I will endeavor to fulfill it.  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)</sub>
